context: Tests whether the agent creates a draft pull request for the existing feature branch using a plain-text conventional-commit title and a succinct body covering exactly the branch changes - and whether the PR actually targets the feature branch (via --head, or by being on it, the way real gh infers it). Checks title format rules, body structure (Summary/Changes/Testing), draft and base flags, and absence of emoji or essay-style padding. Graded from the recorded shim output (pr-record.json), whose head field is the --head value or the current branch at invocation.

checklist.name: Draft PR created
checklist.description: pr-record.json shows the gh shim was called with the create subcommand and --draft (record['draft'] is true).

checklist.name: Base branch set
checklist.description: The create call specifies the base branch as main (record['base'] is 'main').

checklist.name: PR targets the feature branch
checklist.description: record['head'] is feature/replica-routing - either from an explicit --head or from the agent having switched to that branch before invoking gh (the shim records the current branch when --head is absent). Opening the PR while still on main fails this check.

checklist.name: Title is conventional commit format
checklist.description: record['title'] starts with a conventional type prefix such as feat:, fix(scope): or docs: - matching one of the branch's commit types.

checklist.name: Title imperative mood
checklist.description: The title subject verb is imperative (e.g. 'route', 'add'), not past tense or gerund.

checklist.name: Title lower case
checklist.description: Everything after the type prefix in the title begins lower-case (no capitalised first word).

checklist.name: Title no trailing period
checklist.description: The title does not end with a period.

checklist.name: Title under 70 chars
checklist.description: The full title including type prefix is fewer than 70 characters.

checklist.name: No emoji in title or body
checklist.description: Neither the title nor the recorded body contains emoji characters.

checklist.name: Body has Summary section
checklist.description: The body contains a '## Summary' section with one to three sentences describing what the branch changes and why, whether the body was passed via --body or --body-file.

checklist.name: Body Changes bullets cover branch
checklist.description: The body has a '## Changes' section with one bullet per meaningful change on the branch (replica routing feature; routing documentation), no more.

checklist.name: Body has Testing line
checklist.description: The body contains a '## Testing' section. It may state plainly that nothing was run; it must not claim unverified test runs.

checklist.name: No padding sections
checklist.description: The body contains no 'Notes for reviewers', 'Future work', 'Impact' or risk-assessment sections beyond the Summary/Changes/Testing template.

checklist.name: Body does not claim unverified behaviour
checklist.description: The body does not assert behaviour or results that the branch does not demonstrate (e.g. claiming benchmark results that are not in the commits).
